releases.title: Smarter food logging
highlights: Add your own foods — a favourite brand, a home recipe, a supplement — and edit or remove them anytime. Find them fast under the new ⭐ Mine tab.
The food list now learns you: foods you log often rise to the top.
New deli & sausage foods (ham, bologna, hot dog, and more) with a ⚠ Salty flag so you can see the sodium trade-off at a glance.
Search the activity list, and a quick note explaining why GrowSense tracks protein rather than every calorie.

releases.title: The logging calendar
highlights: Tap the date on Today to open a month calendar of your logging — every day shows nutrition, activity and sleep at a glance, with a bar for how close each got to its target.
Days that still need you are outlined in gold — "Fill next" walks through them oldest-first.
Tap any day to see where its numbers came from; one "Looks right" confirms all of that day's estimates together.
The calendar now speaks all six app languages, with Thai weekday and month names.

releases.title: Small refinements
highlights: Account now shows how you signed in — Google, Apple, or email — so you always know which one you used.

releases.title: First production release
highlights: Never lose a day — the recall engine rebuilds missed nutrition, activity, and sleep days from your child's own patterns, always marked as estimates.
Trust calendar — see exactly which days are measured vs estimated, and confirm or correct any of them.
Smarter analytics — week-over-week deltas, trend direction, a growth chart with a habit-scenario band, and a research-weighted readiness score personalized to your child.
Pediatric visit summary PDF — a clean, printable report for your doctor (Premium).
Sign in with Google or Apple, plus password reset.
